小平头顿时也有些为难了，下意识的摸了摸自己的口袋，“我也没带那么多钱啊，要不你给我三万吧，你去领奖也成！”
“我也没有啊！这可怎么办啊……”
麻子脸愁眉苦脸的说道：“你看我这样子，像是能掏出三万块钱的人么？”
“老师，您给我们想想办法吧，我俩都没带那么多钱啊！”
麻子脸再次的向眼镜男申请了援助。
眼镜男沉吟了一下，然后试探的说道：“要不，我给你们一家三万块钱，你把拉环给我，我去兑奖？”
麻子脸和小平头对视了一下，觉得这样他们两人每人还是可以拿到三万块，于是就应了下来：“好，就这么办吧！”
眼镜男顿时露出了窃喜的神色来，然后拿过自己的公文包，开始找起了钱。
刚开始，他的神色还是很欣喜的，不过，随着手上翻包的速度加快，眼镜男的脸色就越来越难看了起来，额头上的汗珠也开始渗出。
终于，眼镜男哀叹了一声，“坏了，今天出门的时候，没带多少钱，我这就三万块钱！你们肯定也不会卖的，眼看着这到手的钱财就这么没有了，真倒霉啊！”
“啊？”
麻子脸和小平头都傻了眼了，眼镜男没带钱，他俩也没有钱，这奖了怎么分啊？
于是，麻子脸坐不住了：“老师，您有学问，有文化，您再帮我们想想办法……”
“哎，要不这样吧，问问别人……”
眼镜男说着，把脸转向了坐在一旁的林逸：“小兄弟，这可是千载难逢的发财好机会啊，你有没有钱，先给他们一人三万，然后你拿着拉环去领奖，一下子就能赚两万！还有比这个更赚钱的路子了么？要不是我没带钱，这好事儿我就自己得了……”
之前，林逸一直冷眼的看着这三个人演戏，很明显，这三个人都是一伙的，麻子脸是甲方，小平头是乙方，眼镜男是托。
林逸虽然在大山里长大，但是却也不是傻子。
别看他身上穿的土气，不过要论学识，却没几个人是他的对手，别说这三个不入流的骗子了。
“我？”

林逸装作很惊讶的样子指了指自己，然后道：“我可以么？”
“可以，现在这个好事儿就降临在了你的头上！”
听林逸问可不可以而不是说他也没有钱，眼镜男顿时大喜，要知道，这么说的，八成包里都有货。
林逸刚想再说什么，只觉得自己的腿被人踢了一下。
林逸用余光向自己的右边看了一眼，那是一个很美的女孩子，和林逸的年纪差不多大。
秀发如水，皮肤白皙，虽然不曾站起来身，但是根据林逸目测，女孩子起码有一米六五左右，算是身材高挑了。
从上了火车之后，就静静的用手机听着歌。
林逸本想撩一下，聊聊天，路上解解闷，但是无奈小妞一直戴个耳塞，让他无从下手。
而此刻，女孩子正一脸焦急的看着林逸，想要说什么，却又有些顾忌，只能用眼神暗示着林逸。
林逸自然知道女孩子的意思，是不要让他上当受骗。
林逸的心头顿时就是一暖，不是说大城市的人都很冷漠么？
看到事不关己，就高高挂起，而女孩子能提醒自己，说明她的心地很好。
于是，女孩子在林逸的心目中的形象顿时加了好几分。
女孩子长的漂亮固然重要，不过心肠歹毒的话，那再好看也没有什么用处。
这是林逸对女孩子的评判标准。
“咳咳！”
女孩子对面的小平头似乎也察觉到了女孩子的行为，顿时大声的咳嗽了起来，狠狠的瞪了女孩子一眼。
女孩子吓得脸色一白，低下头去。
当然，这些小细节自然逃不过林逸的眼睛。
不过，林逸在旅途中本就无聊，在家和老头子生了一肚子气，正没处发泄呢！

正好有几个傻泡送上了门来，林逸哪能错过这个戏弄他们的机会？
不过，女孩子虽然低下了头，却依然的用脚踢着林逸，给他预警。
但是林逸却似乎没有感觉到一般，丝毫不为所动。
“我这只有四万九，没有那么多啊！”
林逸装作老实巴交的样子，如实的说道。
对面的麻子脸和小平头听说林逸有四万九，顿时眼中射出了灿烂的光芒来。
不过，脸上却仍然是一副苦瓜脸：“只有四万九啊，是不是有点儿少了？咱们一人能分到多少啊？”
“四万九除以二，就是两万四千五……”

The little flat head suddenly felt a little embarrassed, and subconsciously touched his pocket, "I don't bring that much money, why don't you give me 30,000, and you can go and receive the prize!"
"Neither do I! What should I do..."
The pockmarked face said with a scowl: "Look at me like this, do I look like someone who can afford 30,000 yuan?"
"Teacher, please think of a way for us. Neither of us has that much money!"
The pock-marked man once again applied for help from the man with glasses.
The man with glasses pondered for a moment, and then said tentatively: "How about I give your family 30,000 yuan, and you give me the ring and I can redeem the prize?"
The pock-marked face and the flat-headed boy looked at each other and felt that they could still get 30,000 yuan each, so they agreed: "Okay, let's do it like this!"
The bespectacled man suddenly showed a look of joy, then took his briefcase and started to look for money.
At first, he looked very happy, but as he rummaged through the bag faster, the bespectacled man's expression became more and more ugly, and beads of sweat began to appear on his forehead.
Finally, the man with glasses lamented, "It's broken. When I went out today, I didn't bring much money. I only have 30,000 yuan! I'm sure you won't sell it. It's so unlucky to see the money you got is gone!"
"Huh?"
The pockmarked face and the crew cut were both dumbfounded. The man with glasses didn't bring any money, and neither of them had any money. How were they going to divide the prize?
So, the pock-marked person couldn't sit still: "Teacher, you are knowledgeable and educated, please help us think of a solution..."
"Hey, how about this? Ask someone else..."
The bespectacled man said, turning to Lin Yi who was sitting next to him: "Little brother, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to make a fortune. If you have any money, give each of them 30,000 yuan first, and then you can take the ring to receive the prize, and you can earn 20,000 yuan in one go! Is there a more profitable way than this? If I hadn't brought any money, I would have gotten this good thing myself..."
Before, Lin Yi had been watching these three people acting with cold eyes. It was obvious that these three people were in the same group. The pockmarked face was Party A, the crew cut was Party B, and the man with glasses was Tuo.
Although Lin Yi grew up in the mountains, he was not a fool.
Despite the tacky clothes he was wearing, when it came to knowledge, few could match him, let alone these three low-level liars.
"Me?"
Lin Yi pretended to be surprised and pointed at himself, then said: "Can I?"
"Okay, now this good thing has happened to you!"
Hearing Lin Yi ask if it was possible instead of saying that he didn't have any money, the man with glasses was immediately overjoyed. You know, if you say so, 80% of the bags are in stock.
Just when Lin Yi was about to say something else, he felt his leg was kicked.
Lin Yi glanced to his right out of the corner of his eye. There was a beautiful girl, about the same age as Lin Yi.
She has watery hair and fair skin. Although she has never stood up, according to Lin Yi's visual inspection, the girl is at least about 1.65 meters tall and is considered tall.
After getting on the train, I quietly listened to music on my mobile phone.
Lin Yi originally wanted to flirt and chat to relieve his boredom on the way, but the girl kept wearing earplugs, which made him unable to start.
At this moment, the girl was looking at Lin Yi anxiously. She wanted to say something, but she had some scruples, so she could only hint at Lin Yi with her eyes.
Lin Yi naturally knew what the girl meant, not to let him be deceived.
Lin Yi's heart suddenly felt warm. Aren't they saying that people in big cities are indifferent?
When she sees that the matter has nothing to do with her, she just hangs it up. If a girl can remind herself, it means she has a good heart.
As a result, the girl's image in Lin Yi's mind suddenly improved a lot.
The girl is prettyBrightness is important, but if you have a vicious heart, no matter how beautiful you look, it's of no use.
This is Lin Yi's criterion for judging girls.
"Ahem!"
The little crew member opposite the girl seemed to have noticed the girl's behavior. He coughed loudly and glared at the girl fiercely.
The girl turned pale with fright and lowered her head.
Of course, these small details cannot escape Lin Yi's eyes.
However, Lin Yi was bored during the trip. He was angry with the old man at home and had nowhere to vent!
Just a few idiots came to the door, how could Lin Yi miss this opportunity to tease them?
However, although the girl lowered her head, she still kicked Lin Yi with her feet to give him an early warning.
But Lin Yi didn't seem to feel it and was unmoved at all.
"I only have forty-nine thousand, not that much!"
Lin Yi pretended to be honest and honest and said truthfully.
When the pock-marked faces and flat-headed men opposite heard that Lin Yi had forty-nine thousand, their eyes suddenly shone brightly.
However, he still had a bitter look on his face: "It's only 49,000. Isn't it a little short? How much can each of us get?"
"Forty-nine thousand divided by two is twenty-four thousand..."
